title: Three-colour geometric owl recovery
intent: Separate the identifiable owl artwork from the photographed shirt and reconstruct it as simple, production-friendly editable vector geometry without importing garment, body, lighting, fold, or perspective pixels.

vector_construction.compound_path_usage: Even-odd compound paths create transparent eye centres and pupil glints without adding a fourth colour.

retained_features: Wide downward dark brow chevron with pointed upper corners
Small inverted crown triangle with a narrow orange accent
Two large orange eye rings with dark pupils and light glints
Rust torso with a deep centre V and tapered lower body
Two dark leaf-shaped wings and two separated triangular feet
normalizations: Removed camera perspective and garment curvature
Restored bilateral symmetry to paired eyes, wings, and feet
Replaced fabric-deformed edges with straight segments or low-complexity Bezier curves
Flattened lighting-driven colour variation into three provisional fills
deliberate_simplifications: Retained one clearly legible geometric glint per pupil and omitted ambiguous secondary light marks
Treated irregular edge fringing as print wear or registration uncertainty rather than new decorative detail

production_notes: SVG is the editable master; each visible component is an individually identified path.
The transparent PNG is a high-resolution convenience export, not a substitute for the vector master.
The preview is flattened on white only to show the intended negative-space appearance.
Before printing, a human must approve geometry, exact colours, white/underbase treatment, final physical size, and registration tolerance.
not_claimed: Exact recovery of the original vector control points
Final print readiness without human proof approval
